_about: Per-car rulings for what geometry cannot decide. Keys are GLB file names without .glb. door_rl/door_rr: "slide" or "swing". A copy named overrides.json in the INPUT folder is read too, and wins.

volkswagen-sharan-vw1-v1._why: Second-generation Sharan (7N): sliding rear doors. Same bounding-box shape as a Mazda 3, so no geometric rule can tell; decided by looking at the render.
